integrity: No independent external audit or certification is claimed; full proof and reproduced integer checks are available.
scientific_limitations: For each r>=3 a sufficiently large integer dilation M exists, but no uniform r-independent lower bound or optimal hopping span is established; exact flatness is not asserted stable under arbitrary perturbations. The infinite assertion is proved analytically, while finite checks are auxiliary.
title: Spectrally isolated negative-integer flat bands on two-site unweighted periodic graphs
